articles.title: Mumbai train alert: 75-day CSMT block from October 1; 8 long-distance trains short-terminated
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Central Railway will impose another 75-day traffic and power block at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) from October 1 to December 15
articles.body: MUMBAI: Central Railway will impose another 75-day traffic and power block at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) from October 1 to December 15 for the redevelopment of the heritage terminus, resulting in eight long-distance trains being short-terminated at Dadar and Thane.The block will cover platforms 14 and 15 and stabling line 15 and will be undertaken in connection with Phase-I of the CSMT redevelopment being executed by the Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA).Foundation work and other essential construction activities will be carried out during the block, with train operations from the two platforms suspended until the work is completed.Seven trains will be short-terminated at Dadar:11002 Ballarshah-CSMT Nandigram Express12810 Howrah-CSMT Express 12112 Amravati-CSMT Express 11020 Bhubaneswar-CSMT Konark Express22120 Madgaon-CSMT Tejas Express22144 Bidar-CSMT Express 22108 Latur-CSMT Express12134 Mangaluru-CSMT Express will be short-terminated at ThaneThe latest block comes after a prolonged closure of platforms 16 and 17 for the same redevelopment project.The earlier block began on February 1 and was initially scheduled for 85 days, till April 26. It was subsequently extended several times, with Central Railway saying the block continued until September 5.During this period, 10-14 long-distance trains were short-terminated at Dadar and Thane at different stages.The decision to take up work on platforms 14 and 15 had been a concern for Central Railway because these platforms handle another 16-18 long-distance services every day.CR had sought to have platforms 16 and 17 made fully operational before additional platforms were taken up for construction, citing the potential for further disruption to long-distance operations.The Rs 2,450-crore CSMT redevelopment project, approved by the Union cabinet in 2022, envisages transforming the terminus into an integrated transport hub while retaining the heritage character of its main Victorian Gothic building.The project includes new buildings, an elevated deck connecting platforms, improved passenger facilities and commercial spaces. articles.title: With 35% monsoon deficit, Karnataka stares at worst drought in 150 years
articles.summary: Karnataka records worst southwest monsoon in 55 years: June–Sept rainfall 35% below normal; September deficit 54%. Mysuru hit hardest; Cauvery dam storage at 52%.
articles.body: MYSURU: Karnataka has recorded its worst southwest monsoon rainfall deficit in 55 years, with rainfall from June 1 to Sept 30 falling 35% below normal, according to data from Karnataka State Natural Disaster Monitoring Centre (KSNDMC). The deficit is the lowest recorded since 1971, surpassing the previous low of 33% in 2002, said G Srinivasa Reddy, former director of KSNDMC.The state received just 551 mm of rainfall against the normal 852 mm during the four-month monsoon season. While rainfall improved in July and August, September saw a sharp reversal, with the state recording a 54% deficit during the month, pushing the seasonal deficit to 35%.Of the 31 revenue districts, Mysuru was the worst affected, with a 59% deficit, followed by Vijayanagara at 57%. Only Bengaluru South recorded rainfall within the normal range, with a deficit of 18%.Usually, rainfall ranging between +19% and -19% is considered to be normal.According to KSNDMC data, in June 2026, the state recorded -42% deficit rainfall, which improved to -29% in July. In Aug, due to further improvement in rainfall, the deficit fell to -23%. However, with weak monsoon in Sept, the state recorded -54% deficit rainfall during the month, bringing the deficit for the June-Sept period to -35%.Meanwhile, Mysuru is the worst-affected district in the entire state with -59% deficit rainfall. According to data, against normal rainfall of 419 mm, Mysuru received just 172 mm from June to Sept.Vijayanagara is the second worst-affected district with -57% deficit rainfall.According to KSNDMC data, among the 31 districts, only Bengaluru South recorded a normal rainfall deficit of -18%.North interior Karnataka is the worst affected with -42% deficit rainfall, followed by south interior Karnataka, which recorded -41% deficit rainfall.Malnad region, comprising the four districts of Kodagu, Shivamogga, Hassan, and Chikkamagaluru recorded -38% deficit rainfall. The coastal region recorded -28% deficit rainfall.With inflow to dams falling, live storage in the four major dams of Cauvery basin fell to 52% of gross capacity. The combined gross capacity of Kabini, Hemavati, KRS, and Harangi is currently 114.6 TMC. However, on Wednesday, the available water was just 59.1 TMC. Inflow to KRS dam stood at just 492 cusecs.According to Reddy, even though SW monsoon withdrawal has reached Gujarat, in Karnataka, it may require another 8-10 days. He added that with the Cauvery basin’s upper catchment areas witnessing drought, the reservoirs did not record any significant inflow.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Mysuru | Silver Rate in Mysuru | Bank Holidays in Mysuru | Public Holidays in MysuruStay updated with the latest Mysuru news. articles.title: Rs 705 crore assets: SP’s Dhanraj Nathwani richer than UP’s richest 2022 poll candidate
articles.summary: SP Rajya Sabha nominee Dhanraj Nathwani declares Rs 705.42 crore assets and Rs 25.93 crore liabilities in affidavit, highest among recent UP candidates.
articles.body: LUCKNOW: Samajwadi Party’s Rajya Sabha nominee Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani has declared assets worth more than Rs 705 crore in his nomination affidavit, an amount that exceeds the declared assets of the richest candidates in recent Uttar Pradesh Assembly and Lok Sabha elections based on publicly available election affidavits.According to election watch and ADR reports for the 2022 UP Assembly elections, BJP’s Amit Agarwal was the richest candidate with declared assets of Rs 148.76 crore, followed by BSP’s S K Sharma with Rs 112.29 crore and SP’s Rahul Yadav with Rs 100.63 crore.According to Nathwani’s affidavit, he has declared movable assets worth Rs 77.75 crore and immovable assets valued at Rs 627.67 crore, taking his total declared assets to Rs 705.42 crore. He has reported liabilities of Rs 25.93 crore and income of Rs 19.61 crore for the assessment year 2025-26.Nathwani describes himself as a professional consultant to Reliance Industries Ltd and a director in several unlisted companies. His income has been shown from consultancy services, director’s remuneration, rental income, capital gains and other sources.His disclosures include investments in shares, mutual funds, bank deposits, insurance products and agricultural, residential and commercial properties.His declared assets are substantially higher than those disclosed by several prominent politicians of Uttar Pradesh in their latest election affidavits. BSP chief Mayawati declared assets of about Rs 111.6 crore, SP president Akhilesh Yadav around Rs 42 crore in his 2024 Lok Sabha affidavit, and chief minister Yogi Adityanath about Rs 1.5 crore in his 2022 Assembly election affidavit.The other SP nominee, Prof Ram Gopal Yadav, has declared total assets of Rs 12.58 crore, comprising Rs 4.61 crore in movable assets and Rs 7.97 crore in immovable assets.His affidavit shows liabilities of Rs 99.86 lakh and an annual income of Rs 47.93 lakh for AY 2025-26. He described himself as a pensioner with income from pension, agriculture and rental earnings.Both Nathwani and Ram Gopal Yadav have declared that they have no pending criminal cases or convictions.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Lucknow | Silver Rate in Lucknow | Bank Holidays in Lucknow | Public Holidays in Lucknow | Lucknow AQI | Weather in Lucknow | Petrol Price in Lucknow | Diesel Price in Lucknow | CNG Price in Lucknow | LPG Price in LucknowStay updated with the latest Lucknow news. articles.title: Over 100 hearings, 22 witnesses: Wife, lover convicted in Meerut ‘blue drum’ murder case; sentencing on Oct 14
articles.summary: Meerut court convicts Muskan Rastogi and lover Sahil Shukla in 2025 “blue drum” murder of Saurabh Rajput; sentencing set for Oct 14.
articles.body: MEERUT: A district and sessions court in Meerut on Wednesday convicted Muskan Rastogi and her lover Sahil Shukla of murdering Muskan’s husband, merchant navy officer Saurabh Rajput, dismembering his body and concealing it in a blue plastic drum filled with cement in March 2025.The verdict came after more than 100 hearings and examination of 22 witnesses, with the court fixing Oct 14 for the pronouncement of the sentence.Prosecution lawyer K K Chaubey said district and sessions judge Arvind Kumar Mishra found both accused guilty of murder and destruction of evidence. Muskan and Sahil appeared before the court through video conferencing. “The court observed that the crime falls into a category that not only shreds the fabric of society but also strikes at the foundation of the husband-wife relationship,” Chaubey said. He added that when the court asked the two to make submissions on the sentence, they said they had nothing to say.Rajput’s mother, Renu Devi, was present at the court when the verdict was pronounced. “We have waited for this day for the last 18 months. We want nothing less than capital punishment for both,” she said.The case dated back to March 2025, when Muskan and Sahil killed Rajput, chopped his body into pieces, and placed the remains in a blue plastic drum filled with cement in an attempt to conceal the crime. The case came to light on March 17 after a foul smell began emanating from the drum, leading to the discovery of the body and subsequent investigation.Muskan and Sahil were arrested following the discovery and remained in custody during the trial. The gruesome manner in which Rajput’s body was concealed led to the case becoming widely known as the “blue drum murder case”. articles.title: Will take China help if Centre and Manipur fail to act: Naga group
articles.summary: Tangkhul Naga group warns border-area residents may seek China’s help if Centre and Manipur fail to protect Naga civilians amid Naga-Kuki-Zo conflict.
articles.body: GUWAHATI: Warning that neglect of Naga civilians in vulnerable Indo-Myanmar border areas could drive them to seek help from neighbouring countries, including China, a Tangkhul Naga student and civil-society group in Manipur on Tuesday demanded urgent action from the Centre and the state govt to ensure their security.“We are extremely tired at this juncture,” Tangkhul Aze Katamnao Long (TAKL), also known as Southern Tangkhul Students’ Union, president Yarchuiso Kashung said in Imphal.“If the Manipur govt and the govt of India are unwilling or unable to protect indigenous citizens, particularly those living in vulnerable border areas, people would have no option but to seek help from neighbouring countries such as China.”Kashung called for immediate action to protect Naga civilians and said, “If the chief minister is unable to protect the state and its people, he should voluntarily resign.”Expressing a sense of alienation among residents of border areas, he said, “When the Manipur state government doesn’t care, and the Central govt doesn’t care, then we, the people living in the border areas, feel like we are not part of Manipur, and not part of the central govt, not part of India.”Kashung cited recent killings of Naga civilians in Tamenglong, Senapati and Kamjong, including a 17-year-old Liangmei Naga boy, three Mao Naga civilians and four Tangkhul Naga civilians at Pilong in Kamjong, and demanded accountability.The statement comes amid continuing tensions linked to the Naga-Kuki-Zo conflict, which began in February and has claimed nearly 50 lives from both sides. articles.summary: Parceria contribuiu para expandir a produção e impulsionar o desenvolvimento da propriedade e sua produção.
articles.body:
Atendimento próximo e soluções financeiras contribuem para o fortalecimento da produção rural na Região Serrana — Foto: Sicredi/Divulgação

A força do agronegócio da Região Serrana do Rio de Janeiro passa pelo trabalho de milhares de produtores rurais que movimentam a economia local e abastecem mercados em todo o estado. Para apoiar esse desenvolvimento, o Sicredi vem ampliando sua atuação na região com soluções financeiras personalizadas e um modelo de atendimento próximo, que acompanha a realidade de cada associado diretamente no campo.

Foi assim com o produtor rural Sidnei de Lima, de Petrópolis, que encontrou no Sicredi o suporte necessário para investir na produção e expandir sua atividade agrícola. Filho de produtores rurais e com décadas de experiência na lavoura, ele cultiva hortaliças como alface, repolho, cebolinha, salsa e alho-poró, atividade que faz parte da história de sua família há gerações.

Antes de acessar uma linha de crédito para custeio agrícola, a propriedade enfrentava desafios que limitavam sua capacidade de investimento e crescimento. A partir da identificação das necessidades do negócio e da construção de uma solução adequada à realidade da produção, foi possível ampliar a compra de insumos, aumentar a área cultivada e elevar significativamente a produtividade.

O resultado foi uma transformação concreta no dia a dia da propriedade. Áreas que antes permaneciam sem cultivo passaram a ser utilizadas, permitindo a ampliação da produção e a geração de novas oportunidades para o negócio familiar.

O diferencial da atuação do Sicredi está na proximidade com o associado. O atendimento é realizado de forma consultiva, considerando as características de cada propriedade, os objetivos do produtor e o momento do seu negócio. Esse acompanhamento possibilita identificar as melhores alternativas para impulsionar a produção e fortalecer a sustentabilidade financeira da atividade rural.

Esse modelo de relacionamento reflete o propósito da instituição cooperativa financeira, de construir soluções que contribuam para o crescimento coletivo. Independentemente do porte da propriedade, da cultura produzida ou do volume de investimentos necessários, o Sicredi acredita que cada produtor desempenha um papel fundamental no desenvolvimento econômico e social das comunidades onde atua.

Na Região Serrana, onde a agricultura possui forte relevância para a geração de empregos e renda, a presença da instituição busca justamente fortalecer quem está no campo diariamente, produzindo alimentos e movimentando a economia local. A proposta é estar ao lado do associado em todas as etapas da jornada, oferecendo crédito, orientação e apoio para transformar projetos em resultados.

"Quando conhecemos de perto a realidade do produtor, conseguimos entender suas necessidades e encontrar a solução mais adequada para cada momento do negócio. Nosso compromisso é ser um parceiro de longo prazo, contribuindo para que ele produza mais, tenha mais segurança e continue investindo no crescimento da sua propriedade", reforça a instituição financeira.

Com expansão na Região Serrana do Rio de Janeiro, o Sicredi reafirma seu compromisso com o agronegócio local e com o desenvolvimento das comunidades, fortalecendo negócios de todos os tamanhos e construindo, junto aos associados, novas oportunidades para o campo prosperar.

O Sicredi é uma instituição financeira que em 2027 completará 125 anos de história, mais de 10,5 milhões de associados e presença em todo o Brasil. Com mais de 3.100 mil agências, oferece mais de 300 produtos e serviços financeiros para pessoas, empresas e o agronegócio, atuando com um modelo que valoriza o relacionamento próximo, a participação dos associados e o desenvolvimento das regiões onde está presente.

articles.title: Paquistão faz ataque aéreo no Afeganistão; governo afegão relata 9 mortos | G1
articles.standfirst: Afeganistão diz que mulheres e crianças morreram nos bombardeios; Paquistão afirma ter atingido esconderijos de militantes.
articles.summary: Afeganistão diz que mulheres e crianças morreram nos bombardeios; Paquistão afirma ter atingido esconderijos de militantes.
articles.body:
Pessoas observam os escombros de uma casa danificada em um ataque aéreo que o Talibã atribuiu ao Paquistão, no distrito de Garmsir, no Afeganistão. — Foto: Stringer / Reuters

O Paquistão realizou ataques aéreos durante a noite em duas províncias do Afeganistão , informaram os dois países nesta quinta-feira (1º). O governo afegão afirmou que nove mulheres e crianças morreram e outras 11 pessoas ficaram feridas nos bombardeios.

O Ministério da Informação do Paquistão disse que os ataques tiveram como alvo esconderijos de militantes em dois locais e que os “relatórios iniciais sugerem” a morte de 22 combatentes. As alegações de vítimas feitas por ambos os lados não puderam ser verificadas de forma independente.

Os ataques ocorrem em meio a repetidos confrontos transfronteiriços entre os dois países. O Paquistão tem realizado bombardeios dentro do território afegão desde que as tensões entre os dois vizinhos se agravaram drasticamente no início deste ano. Os dois países mantêm disputas de longa data sobre atividades de grupos armados na região da fronteira.

A Missão das Nações Unidas no Afeganistão informou na semana passada que documentou mais de 1.100 mortes e feridos civis no Afeganistão causados por violência transfronteiriça até agora neste ano.

O Paquistão nega atacar civis e afirma que seus alvos são militantes responsáveis por ataques em território paquistanês. O Afeganistão nega abrigar esses grupos armados.

articles.title: Tecnologia fortalece agricultura familiar em Teresópolis | G1
articles.standfirst: Crédito e atendimento próximo ajudaram produtor a modernizar a propriedade e ampliar a eficiência.
articles.summary: Crédito e atendimento próximo ajudaram produtor a modernizar a propriedade e ampliar a eficiência.
articles.body:
Acesso facilitado ao crédito permitiu investimentos que impulsionaram a modernização e o desenvolvimento da propriedade rural — Foto: Sicredi/Divulgação

A busca por mais produtividade e melhores condições de trabalho tem levado agricultores familiares da Região Serrana do Rio de Janeiro a investir em tecnologia para fortalecer suas propriedades. Em Teresópolis, o produtor rural Manoel Maicon encontrou no Sicredi o apoio necessário para transformar um projeto antigo em realidade e dar um novo passo no desenvolvimento do seu negócio.

Morador da localidade de Bom Sucesso, o agricultor trabalha há cerca de 15 anos com a produção de verduras em uma propriedade familiar. Após assumir a atividade ao lado do cunhado, ele enfrentava dificuldades para acessar linhas de crédito que permitissem investir em equipamentos e melhorar a operação no campo.

Entre os principais desafios estava o transporte da produção dentro da propriedade, uma atividade que exigia esforço físico e impactava a rotina de trabalho. O objetivo da família era investir em tecnologia que proporcionasse mais eficiência, aumentasse a capacidade produtiva e trouxesse mais segurança para o futuro da atividade agrícola.

A solução veio por meio do acesso ao crédito para aquisição de um minitrator, equipamento que passou a auxiliar as atividades diárias da propriedade. O investimento permitiu modernizar parte da operação e tornar o trabalho mais ágil, contribuindo para o crescimento do negócio rural.

Além da solução financeira, o produtor destaca a proximidade no relacionamento como um dos diferenciais da instituição financeira. Segundo ele, o acompanhamento aconteceu diretamente na propriedade, com orientação sobre as possibilidades de crédito e apoio durante todas as etapas do processo.

Para agricultores familiares, que muitas vezes precisam conciliar a produção com demandas administrativas e burocráticas, o atendimento próximo pode representar um fator decisivo para viabilizar investimentos. No caso de Manoel Maicon, a realização de atendimentos e encaminhamentos diretamente no sítio facilitou o acesso às soluções necessárias para o desenvolvimento da propriedade.

A história reflete uma realidade comum na Região Serrana, onde milhares de produtores rurais enfrentam desafios para modernizar suas atividades e ampliar sua capacidade produtiva. Ao atuar próximo do associado e compreender sua rotina, o Sicredi busca identificar oportunidades que contribuam para a geração de renda, aumento da produtividade e fortalecimento dos negócios locais.

Com atuação crescente na região, a instituição financeira reforça seu compromisso com o desenvolvimento do campo, apoiando produtores rurais de diferentes perfis e portes. Além de oferecer crédito, a proposta é construir relacionamentos duradouros e estar presente nos momentos em que o associado precisa transformar planos em resultados.

O Sicredi é uma instituição financeira que em 2027 completará 125 anos de história, mais de 10,5 milhões de associados e presença em todo o Brasil. Com mais de 3.100 mil agências, oferece mais de 300 produtos e serviços financeiros para pessoas, empresas e o agronegócio, atuando com um modelo que valoriza o relacionamento próximo, a participação dos associados e o desenvolvimento das regiões onde está presente.

articles.summary: Festival gratuito reúne rock, blues, manobras radicais e 200 motoclubes entre os dias 9 e 12 de outubro no Parque de Exposições.
articles.body:
Evento no Parque de Exposições Latiff Mussi reúne praça de alimentação, camping e atrações para toda a família — Foto: Divulgação

A programação do Macaé Moto Week 2026 foi atualizada e contará com 30 bandas de rock e blues divididas em dois palcos, além do aguardado show do Capital Inicial na véspera do feriado, dia 11 de outubro. Apontado como o maior evento do gênero no Norte Fluminense, o festival acontece de 9 a 12 de outubro no Parque de Exposições Latiff Mussi. A entrada é gratuita, com a sugestão de doação de 1 kg de alimento não perecível.

A estrutura do evento prevê público de cerca de 20 mil pessoas por dia e a recepção de mais de 200 motoclubes. O espaço contará com áreas para camping e motorhome, espaço de convivência, praça de alimentação e atrações como o show de manobras radicais da equipe Negretti. Os shows se dividem entre a Arena MMW (palco principal) e o Palco Loud, dedicado ao cenário underground e alternativo.

A abertura oficial ocorre na sexta-feira (9), a partir das 18h30, com performances de bandas como Tutti Fruti, Faixa Etária e Segredo de Estado. Ao longo do fim de semana, sobem aos palcos nomes como Cilindrada, VMAX e os macaenses do Back in Blues, que trazem clássicos do gênero e rock 'n' roll no feriado de segunda-feira (12).

A apresentação principal do Capital Inicial está marcada para domingo (11), às 23h30, reunindo sucessos das quatro décadas de carreira do grupo. Integrando o calendário oficial do município e o circuito nacional de motociclismo, o festival fomenta o turismo, a cultura e a economia regional. Mais informações e a grade completa estão disponíveis no perfil oficial no Instagram (@macaemotoweek).

articles.summary: Formação atende à Lei Lucas e amplia o preparo das equipes para agir em situações de emergência nas unidades de ensino.
articles.body:
A capacitação busca ampliar o preparo dos profissionais que atuam nas escolas — Foto: Secom

A Prefeitura de Rio das Ostras, por meio da Secretaria de Guarda, Trânsito e Ordem Pública, através da Defesa Civil, realizou mais uma capacitação de colaboradores da rede municipal de ensino em primeiros socorros, com foco nos procedimentos previstos pela Lei Lucas. A formação aconteceu na Escola Municipal Professora Marinete Coelho de Souza, em Cantagalo, e faz parte de um cronograma que prevê a capacitação das equipes de todas as unidades escolares do Município.

Durante o treinamento, os participantes receberam orientações sobre prevenção de acidentes, identificação de situações que exigem atendimento imediato e procedimentos básicos que podem ser adotados até a chegada de uma equipe especializada.

A capacitação busca ampliar o preparo dos profissionais que atuam nas escolas para que possam responder de maneira rápida e segura diante de possíveis emergências no ambiente escolar.

A previsão da Defesa Civil é estender o treinamento gradativamente às demais unidades da rede municipal de ensino, ampliando o número de profissionais capacitados.

LEI LUCAS – A Lei Federal nº 13.722/2018 , conhecida como Lei Lucas, determina a capacitação em noções básicas de primeiros socorros para professores e funcionários de estabelecimentos de ensino e de recreação infantil. A legislação foi criada após a morte de uma criança de 10 anos que sofreu uma emergência durante uma atividade escolar e não recebeu atendimento adequado a tempo.

articles.title: Lixo hospitalar: seringas e tubos de sangue são jogados em Taguatinga | G1
articles.standfirst: Material foi coletado pelos bombeiros e encaminhado ao Samu para descarte adequado. Região é cercada de clínicas e hospitais, mas responsáveis pelo material não foram identificados.
articles.summary: O lixo hospitalar em Taguatinga, incluindo seringas e tubos de sangue, foi recolhido pelos bombeiros após denúncia de descarte irregular no Pistão Sul.
articles.body:
Um vídeo gravado nesta quarta-feira (30) mostra uma pilha de lixo hospitalar espalhado e descartado de forma irregular ao lado de uma clínica no Pistão Sul em Taguatinga , no Distrito Federal.

Na imagem, é possível identificar tubos de coleta usados, seringas, luvas descartáveis e cateteres espalhados pelo gramado , próximo ao estacionamento de uma clínica.

Tubos de coleta usados, seringas, luvas e cateteres foram encontrados próximo a uma clínica. — Foto: Reprodução

A região onde o material foi encontrado é movimentada e conta com shoppings, mercados, lojas e restaurantes, além de diversos estabelecimentos de saúde.

De acordo com os relatos, o descarte ocorre dessa forma há pelo menos uma semana.

O Corpo de Bombeiros do DF atendeu a ocorrência e encaminhou os resíduos ao Samu para descarte adequado.

A DF Legal informou que a pasta não foi acionada, mas vai incluir o endereço no cronograma de fiscalização para que o responsável seja identificado.

As polícias Militar e Civil também foram acionadas. O Serviço de Limpeza Urbana (SLU) não compareceu ao local.

articles.title: Coworking amplia possibilidades para profissionais em Petrópolis | G1
articles.standfirst: Empresário transformou a experiência como associado na criação de um coworking voltado à conexão e colaboração.
articles.summary: Empresário transformou a experiência como associado na criação de um coworking voltado à conexão e colaboração.
articles.body:
Princípios do cooperativismo e a relação próxima com o Sicredi inspiraram o associado Wesseley na criação de um espaço de coworking em Petrópolis — Foto: Sicredi/Divulgação

A proximidade, o relacionamento humano e a construção conjunta foram algumas das referências que inspiraram o empresário Wesseley Freitas a criar um espaço de coworking em Petrópolis, na Região Serrana do Rio de Janeiro. Associado do Sicredi, ele encontrou na instituição não apenas apoio para seus projetos, mas também valores que passaram a fazer parte de sua trajetória pessoal e profissional.

O primeiro contato mais próximo aconteceu após um convite para participar de uma palestra na cidade. Na ocasião, Wesseley pôde conhecer melhor o Sicredi, sua equipe e a forma de atuação da instituição. Segundo ele, a simplicidade presente nas relações, independentemente dos cargos ocupados, foi um dos aspectos que mais o marcaram. A partir desse encontro, veio o convite para se tornar associado, dando início a uma parceria construída com negócios, orientações, conquistas e amizades.

“Foi um ponto muito marcante para mim. A simplicidade, independentemente do tamanho ou do peso do crachá, fez toda a diferença. Depois desse primeiro encontro, fomos caminhando e entrelaçando cada vez mais os negócios, os conselhos e as amizades”, conta.

Um espaço pensado para as necessidades da cidade

Com experiência no ramo imobiliário, Wesseley Freitas percebeu que Petrópolis precisava de espaços corporativos capazes de oferecer praticidade aos profissionais e empreendedores. O objetivo era reunir, em um único ambiente, a estrutura necessária para trabalhar, reduzindo preocupações com despesas e serviços que normalmente acompanham a locação de uma sala comercial, como condomínio, água, climatização e internet.

Assim nasceu o espaço de coworking Zygos, estruturado para oferecer salas e horários flexíveis, de acordo com as necessidades de diferentes atividades profissionais. A proposta permite que os clientes encontrem, em um só lugar, os recursos necessários para desenvolver seus negócios com mais autonomia e organização.

Além da estrutura física, o espaço carrega um significado especial. Os princípios do cooperativismo estão descritos em uma de suas paredes, traduzindo visualmente valores que orientam a relação de Wesseley com seus clientes, parceiros e projetos. A inspiração no Sicredi aparece na valorização das pessoas, na proximidade e na disposição para construir soluções em conjunto.

Empresário do ramo imobiliário, Wesseley conta que conheceu de perto os espaços de coworking disponibilizados nas agências do Sicredi e identificou nesse modelo uma oportunidade de investimento. Inspirado pela proposta de oferecer ambientes compartilhados, funcionais e voltados à conexão entre pessoas, decidiu criar a Zygos, um novo espaço de coworking em Petrópolis.

A parceria próxima com o Sicredi contribuiu para que Wesseley Freitas transformasse seu projeto em um espaço de coworking em Petrópolis inspirado nos princípios do cooperativismo — Foto: Sicredi/Divulgação

“Meus projetos, depois que conheci o Sicredi, eu apresento à equipe e nós avaliamos juntos. Tenho um suporte imedesse espaço foi algo muito bem pensado e elaborado, com pessoas ao meu lado que participaram de todo o processo”, afirma.

Na avaliação do empresário, o diferencial está justamente na forma próxima e natural como o relacionamento acontece. Ele destaca que o atendimento vai além de uma relação convencional entre instituição financeira e associado, pois envolve pessoas dispostas a compreender o projeto, pensar em conjunto e acompanhar os desafios do empreendimento.

Com estrutura e horários flexíveis, a Zygos foi criada para atender profissionais e empreendedores que buscam praticidade para desenvolver suas atividades. Ao transformar uma necessidade percebida em Petrópolis em uma solução para outros profissionais, Wesseley criou um ambiente que favorece a conexão entre pessoas, ideias e oportunidades, refletindo valores presentes em sua trajetória como associado do Sicredi, como confiança, proximidade e colaboração.

O Sicredi é uma instituição financeira que em 2027 completará 125 anos de história, mais de 10,5 milhões de associados e presença em todo o Brasil. Com mais de 3.100 mil agências, oferece mais de 300 produtos e serviços financeiros para pessoas, empresas e o agronegócio, atuando com um modelo que valoriza o relacionamento próximo, a participação dos associados e o desenvolvimento das regiões onde está presente.

articles.title: 7700 e 7500: Como tripulação declarou emergência em voo para Israel | G1
articles.standfirst: Aeronave emitiu os códigos 7700 e 7500 para comunicar situação. Copiloto tentou tomar o controle e derrubar voo que seguia de Dubai para Tel Aviv, segundo autoridades israelenses.
articles.summary: Aeronave emitiu os códigos para comunicar situação. Copiloto tentou tomar o controle e derrubar voo que seguia de Dubai para Tel Aviv, segundo autoridades israelenses.
articles.body:
Um avião que seguia dos Emirados Árabes Unidos para Israel declarou emergência no ar após o copiloto esfaquear o piloto da aeronave, nesta quarta-feira (30). O voo acabou sendo desviado para a Arábia Saudita, onde o agressor foi preso.

✈️ A aeronave da FlyDubai havia saído de Dubai e tinha como destino Tel Aviv. Segundo as autoridades israelenses, o copiloto tentou tomar o controle do avião e derrubá-lo quando a aeronave se aproximava do espaço aéreo de Israel. Ele acabou sendo contido por passageiros e tripulantes.

A aeronave emitiu o primeiro alerta de emergência às 8h31 do horário local (2h31, em Brasília). Neste aviso, o avião enviou para o controle de tráfego aéreo o código 7700 . Esse número significa que voo está enfrentando uma emergência geral.

Sete minutos depois, às 8h38 (2h38, em Brasília), a aeronave mudou o código para 7500 . Esse número indica uma possível interferência ilícita, termo usado na aviação para situações como um sequestro ou tentativa de tomada de controle da aeronave.

Para transmitir esses códigos, a tripulação precisa selecioná-los no equipamento conhecido como transponder . É esse dispositivo permite que os sistemas de controle de tráfego aéreo identifiquem e acompanhem a aeronave.

Silvio Monteiro Jr., coronel aviador da Força Aérea Brasileira (FAB), explica que o uso do transponder se consolidou na aviação na década de 1950.

💡 Segundo ele, o equipamento permite selecionar quatro dígitos em um painel. Essa combinação funciona como um código usado pelos sistemas de controle de tráfego aéreo para identificar a aeronave.

"Essa identidade de 4 dígitos, normalmente, é fornecida pelo próprio sistema de controle do espaço aéreo, internacionalmente podendo usar o termo 'squawk'. Exemplo: 'squawk 4336' é uma orientação para que a aeronave selecione esses números em seu transponder", afirma.

"Os códigos mais comuns, empregados em situações anormais, são: 7500 para interferência ilícita, 7600 para falha de comunicações e 7700 para emergências."

O coronel afirma ainda que o uso de cada um dos códigos gera procedimentos diferentes nos órgãos de controle do espaço aéreo, para esclarecer a situação e identificar a necessidade de adotar medidas.

O uso do código 7700 indica uma emergência e faz com que a aeronave receba prioridade e assistência dos órgãos de controle, podendo, por exemplo, ter preferência para pousar.

Já o uso do 7500 indica uma possível interferência ilícita e aciona procedimentos específicos de segurança e coordenação com as autoridades.

Infográfico mostra rota de avião que tinha Tel Aviv como destino mas desviou após copiloto atacar piloto, no que o governo de Israel classificou como tentativa de ataque terrorista, em 30 de setembro de 2026. — Foto: arte/ g1

Esses códigos existem desde antes dos atentados terroristas de 11 de setembro de 2001, quando extremistas sequestraram quatro aviões nos Estados Unidos. Dois deles foram jogados contra as torres do World Trade Center, em Nova York.

Segundo Monteiro, os atentados de 2001 provocaram mudanças nas regras de aviação, principalmente nas medidas de segurança. No entanto, os códigos usados pelo transponder para indicar emergências permaneceram os mesmos.

O avião que transportava passageiros que estavam no voo da Flydubai com destino a Israel, saído dos Emirados Árabes Unidos e desviado para a Arábia Saudita após emitir um sinal de emergência, chega ao Aeroporto Internacional Ben Gurion, em Lod, perto de Tel Aviv, Israel. — Foto: Ammar Awad / Reuters

O ataque aconteceu quando o avião, que levava 174 pessoas, já estava próximo de Israel e sobrevoava a Jordânia. Segundo autoridades israelenses, o copiloto atacou o piloto com uma faca. Os dois entraram em confronto físico.

A briga deixou os dois feridos e fez com que a aeronave perdesse o controle temporariamente. O voo chegou a despencar cerca de 4.300 metros em 30 segundos , segundo dados do site de monitoramento aéreo Flightradar24.

Além disso, passageiros relataram ter ouvido gritos e pedidos de ajuda vindos da cabine de comando. Um deles afirmou que conseguiu entrar na cabine e puxar o controle do avião para interromper a queda .

Após o ataque, outros pilotos que estavam entre os passageiros assumiram o controle da aeronave e ajudaram no pouso, segundo uma autoridade israelense ouvida pela Reuters. O avião aterrissou em segurança na Arábia Saudita.

O piloto atacado foi levado para um hospital, onde está internado. Já o copiloto foi preso.

Ainda não há uma explicação oficial para o motivo pelo qual o copiloto teria atacado o comandante. Autoridades israelenses afirmam que o episódio foi uma tentativa de ataque terrorista e que o objetivo era matar os passageiros israelenses.

Em depoimento, o copiloto afirmou que não é ligado a nenhum grupo jihadista e que agiu por conta própria .

As autoridades investigam se houve motivação política ou religiosa, um conflito pessoal entre os pilotos ou outra razão para o ataque.

Passageiros ensanguentados após briga entre pilotos em voo da Flydubai rumo a Israel que foi desviado para a Arábia Saudita em 30 de setembro de 2026. — Foto: Reprodução/redes sociais

articles.title: MPPE cobra estudo ambiental de projeto ligado a Neymar em Tamandaré | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo promotoria, empresas não apresentaram estudo de impacto ambiental, obrigatório para construções de mais de 5 mil metros quadrados.
articles.summary: Segundo promotoria, empresas não apresentaram estudo de impacto ambiental, obrigatório para construções de mais de 5 mil metros quadrados no município do Litoral Sul de Pernambuco.
articles.body:
O Ministério Público de Pernambuco (MPPE) recomendou a suspensão de cinco empreendimentos imobiliários em construção em Tamandaré , no Litoral Sul de Pernambuco. Segundo o órgão, os projetos não apresentaram estudo de impacto ambiental, documento considerado obrigatório para espaços que ultrapassam 5 mil metros quadrados no município (veja vídeo acima).

Entre os imóveis citados, está o Projeto 28, da Due Empreendimentos Imobiliários Ltda., que tem uma parceria com a Neymar Sport e Marketing, empresa ligada ao jogador do Santos, para a construção da chamada Rota DUE Caribe Brasileiro. O projeto prevê a implantação de 28 empreendimentos turísticos no litoral de Pernambuco e Alagoas.

De acordo com o MPPE, também foram incluídos na recomendação:

Ecoresort Tamandaré, da Ecoresort Tamandaré Ltda.;

Villa Arcos Residence, da Reis Prime SPE Ltda.;

Green Sea Essence, da D'Albuquerque Empreendimentos Ltda.

Segundo o MPPE, documentos dos próprios empreendimentos indicam que os locais estão sendo construídos em área superior ao limite de 5 mil metros quadrados estabelecido pela legislação municipal de Tamandaré.

Procurada, a Due Empreendimentos informou que está regularizada tecnicamente para a construção do empreendimento (veja nota mais abaixo) . A TV Globo tenta contato com os responsáveis pelos outros projetos citados.

A promotora de Justiça Belize Câmara, coordenadora do Centro de Defesa do Meio Ambiente do MPPE, explicou que a recomendação não tem caráter punitivo e não significa que os empreendimentos estejam impedidos de continuar ou de serem instalados.

"Não é uma medida punitiva, não significa que os empreendimentos não vão poder se instalar. Apenas é uma medida de prevenção para dimensionar adequadamente os impactos desses empreendimentos. O estudo de impacto ambiental é como um exame que você faz antes de uma cirurgia. Ele vai identificar possíveis impactos ao meio ambiente e à ordem urbanística para ou evitar esses impactos ou reduzir esses impactos, ou também mitigar ou compensar esses impactos. Então, é de interesse de toda a população e também dos adquirentes dos empreendimentos que esses impactos sejam corretamente dimensionados", afirmou.

Segundo a promotora, as empresas devem informar se vão acatar a recomendação. Caso concordem, terão que revisar as licenças para a realização dos estudos de impacto ambiental. Se houver recusa, o Ministério Público poderá recorrer à Justiça para tentar obter a realização dos estudos por meio de decisão judicial.

"Eles têm um prazo para responder se acatam ou não a recomendação e, na sequência, o Ministério Público vai estudar a medida a ser adotada. Caso eles acatem, eles vão revisar essas licenças para realizar o estudo de impacto ambiental. Se eles não acatarem, aí o Ministério Público tem à disposição uma ação judicial para tentar obter essa prestação pelo Judiciário", disse.

Ainda de acordo com a promotora, o estudo funciona como uma forma de identificar previamente possíveis impactos ambientais e urbanísticos e estabelecer medidas para evitá-los, reduzi-los, mitigá-los ou compensá-los.

"A gente tem que lembrar que a gente não deve olhar o impacto de um empreendimento. A gente deve perceber que a cidade está recebendo vários empreendimentos de uma vez só. Então, esses impactos são cumulativos. Eles se somam, não há desenvolvimento sem sustentabilidade e sem planejamento. E é isso que nós estamos tentando conter em Tamandaré", explicou.

Praia de Tamandaré, no litoral sul de Pernambuco — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

De acordo com o MPPE, o órgão recomendou à prefeitura de Tamandaré suspender cautelarmente alvarás e licenças, embargar as obras, abrir processo de revisão e não conceder novas licenças ou "habite-se".

Já à Agência Estadual de Meio Ambiente (CPRH), foi recomendado:

instaurar revisão com garantia de defesa às empresas;

não emitir nem renovar licenças sem o Estudo de Impacto Ambiental (EIA) e o Relatório de Impacto Ambiental (RIMA) aprovado;

verificar se as obras atingem unidades de conservação, comunicando o ICMBio;

calcular a compensação ambiental devida.

A TV Globo procurou a CPRH e a prefeitura de Tamandaré. Os dois órgãos informaram que estão avaliando a recomendação apresentada pelo Ministério Público.

Procurada pela TV Globo , a Projeto 28 Empreendimento Imobiliário SPE LTDA e a Due Incorporadora afirmaram, por meio de nota, que estão regularizadas tecnicamente para a construção do empreendimento.

contam com o Alvará de Construção nº 47/2025, com validade até 29/05/2028, expedido pelo município;

licença de instalação nº 01.25.07.004337-2 com validade até 6 de julho de 2028, expedida pela Agência Estadual do Meio Ambiente (CPRH);

se mantém à disposição para prestar esclarecimentos e colaborar no âmbito do procedimento em curso;

reafirmam seu compromisso com a legalidade, a transparência e o cumprimento das exigências urbanísticas e ambientais aplicáveis ao empreendimento.

articles.title: ‘Quagmire’ over: Trump hails US exit from Iraq after 12-year ISIS mission
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday hailed the withdrawal of American troops from Iraq as an “orderly” end to a 12-year mission against the Islamic
articles.body: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday hailed the withdrawal of American troops from Iraq as an “orderly” end to a 12-year mission against the Islamic State group, as the last US forces left an air base in northern Iraq under a deal between Washington and Baghdad.Trump described the withdrawal, completed by the September 30 deadline, as the end of what he called “a very expensive excursion into Hell”. At a White House event, he said the US involvement in Iraq had resulted from “very bad decision making” and called the conflict a “quagmire” that had lasted for many years.“It's been a long time with very bad decision making that got us involved in this quagmire in the first place. It was a quagmire. For many, many years it lasted. But soon that part of history will be over,” Trump said.He said the withdrawal represented a victory for the US and Iraq and marked a victory over the Islamic State group.US shifts to Iraqi-led securityPentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said US troops and equipment had completed an “orderly departure” from the air base in Irbil in Iraq's semi-autonomous Kurdish region.“This milestone reflects the success of a 12-year campaign that defeated ISIS as an organised military threat in Iraq and across the region,” Parnell said. “It also marks a transition from a wartime coalition mission to an Iraqi-led security effort supported by a more normal bilateral security relationship.”He said the US military would continue to provide “targeted training and intelligence support” to Iraqi partners.Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi presided over the handover ceremony and described the withdrawal as the start of a “new phase” centred on Iraq's sovereignty and stronger institutions.He said Iraqi security forces would continue fighting Islamic State and that the government would ensure non-state groups no longer held weapons.Withdrawal comes amid Iran warThe US exit comes as Washington remains engaged in a war with Iran that has also spilled into Iraq.Iran-backed Iraqi militias have attacked US positions, while the US has carried out strikes against militia strongholds. Bases in the Kurdish region have faced repeated attacks since the US and Israel launched their war against Iran on February 28.Trump also compared the Iraq conflict with his administration's military actions in Iran, arguing that the Iran war and a one-day US operation in Venezuela earlier this year had taken less time and resulted in fewer US military deaths.The withdrawal also reflects Washington's broader effort in recent years to shift its strategic focus from the Middle East towards Asia. That shift has been complicated by renewed US military involvement in the region.US presence in Iraq dates back to 2003The US invaded Iraq in 2003 to overthrow Saddam Hussein and withdrew its forces in 2011.Three years later, Baghdad invited a smaller US-led mission to help fight Islamic State after the group seized large areas of Iraq. As the group was reduced to scattered sleeper cells, Washington and Baghdad agreed in 2024 to wind down the mission.Most US troops left Iraqi bases last year, leaving several hundred in the semi-autonomous Kurdish region until Wednesday's final withdrawal.The departure was welcomed by Iran-backed groups but has also raised concerns in parts of Iraq, particularly the Kurdish region, over the possibility of renewed Islamic State attacks and further strikes by Iran-linked groups.Questions remain over Iraqi militiasThe future of Iraq's powerful armed groups remains uncertain. Baghdad had initially linked the September 30 US withdrawal deadline to the disarmament of non-state militias.Some smaller groups agreed to hand over their weapons, but powerful Iran-aligned militias rejected the move or imposed conditions. Al-Zaidi has since pushed the disarmament deadline to June 2027, according to an interview with The New York Times earlier this month.The Kurdish regional government's Peshmerga Ministry said the region had faced more than 1,000 drone and ballistic-missile attacks during the recent US-Iran conflict. It expressed concern over the departure of US forces and the removal of American air defence systems.Iran-backed groups, meanwhile, celebrated the US withdrawal.Kataib Hezbollah security official Abu Mujahid al-Assaf called the departure “the beginning of full sovereignty” but warned the Iraqi government against carrying out what he described as American plans.The Islamic Resistance in Iraq, an umbrella group of Iran-backed militias, said it was “not bound by any timeline or agreement” announced by the government or political groups, while saying it remained open to dialogue over weapons and Iraq's sovereignty.You use AI every day. articles.title: ‘Might as well disband you’: SC slams UP police for cover-up job
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Supreme Court on Wednesday slammed Uttar Pradesh police for not naming the accused in a road accident case despite the complainant catching him
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Supreme Court on Wednesday slammed Uttar Pradesh police for not naming the accused in a road accident case despite the complainant catching him on the spot and handing him over to police. It said it would be better if investigations in all criminal cases were handed over to CBI if the state police worked with an agenda and did cover-up jobs.A bench of Justices Sanjay Kumar and Sanjeev Sachdeva asked why the state police should not be disbanded in view of its functioning.“In everything you have an agenda. How will people trust you if this is how you proceed with matters? It is better if we ask the CBI to step in all UP police investigations. We might as well disband UP police. This nonsense has to stop at some point,” the court said.How will people trust police: SCSupreme Court added that the affidavit filed by Shobhit Kumar, circle officer of Khurja in Bulandshahr, who was directed to give an explanation, was “utterly uninspiring”.“Toeing the line is one thing but bending over is another. And this kind of cover up job... less said the better,” SC said and summoned the officer to be present in court to give an explanation on his conduct.“The said officer shall be present before court on next date to account for the same. It would be open to him to file a better affidavit explaining as to why FIR No. 195/2026 was filed on Aug 19 against an unknown motorcycle rider when it is the admitted fact that the said rider was apprehended at the spot. In paragraph 6 of aforestated affidavit, the name of the motorcycle rider is disclosed as Tushar s/o Prempal. The reason as to why the name was left blank in the FIR initially and was, thereafter, supplemented, requires to be explained,” the bench said in its order.The bench sought an explanation on why an FIR was filed against unknown person in the case. “Why did you write unknown if the person was caught at the spot? Why did you register the FIR against an unknown motorcycle rider if he was caught on the spot? How will people trust the police?” the bench asked.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: 'A hero': Trump hails Indian captain after Flydubai attack, calls co-pilot ‘perhaps a terrorist’
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump has hailed Indian Flydubai captain Smit Machchhar as “a hero” after he was stabbed by his co-pilot during a mid-air attack on an
articles.body: US President Donald Trump has hailed Indian Flydubai captain Smit Machchhar as “a hero” after he was stabbed by his co-pilot during a mid-air attack on an Israel-bound flight.“In a way he was a hero,” Trump said of Machchhar, saying the badly wounded pilot still managed to open the cockpit door and call for help.Trump, while speaking about the incident, also described the co-pilot as “perhaps a terrorist or perhaps a whack job”, as the motive behind the attack remained under investigation.The Dubai-to-Tel Aviv Flydubai flight plunged thousands of feet during the confrontation in the cockpit, triggering panic among passengers. The aircraft was eventually diverted and landed safely in Saudi Arabia.US says no credible threats after Flydubai incidentUS homeland security secretary Markwayne Mullin said there were currently “no credible threats” directed at the United States following the incident.“We have no credible threats to us right now. We take every incident like this very serious, and we continue to look at the procedures that we have in place and continue to make sure the American people are safe,” Mullin said, according to Fox News.The statement came as aviation authorities reviewed security procedures following the attack on the Flydubai flight.Indian captain helped passengers overpower attackerThe captain was identified as Indian national Smit Machchhar, a seasoned pilot with more than 13 years of commercial aviation experience. He has around 9,750 flying hours, predominantly on Boeing 737 aircraft, and previously spent about 11 years with SpiceJet, where he served as a Line Training Captain, news agency ANI reported.Despite suffering serious stab wounds, Machchhar reportedly managed to open the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to enter and restrain the attacker.You use AI every day. articles.title: Hasina: Restore democratic rights, rule of law in Bangladesh
articles.summary: TOI Correspondent from Dhaka: Expressing concern over what she described as a renewed threat from militancy and violent extremism, former prime minister
articles.body: TOI Correspondent from Dhaka: Expressing concern over what she described as a renewed threat from militancy and violent extremism, former prime minister and Awami League President Sheikh Hasina, who is facing the death penalty at home, has called for the restoration of democratic rights, political participation and the rule of law in Bangladesh, saying the country is facing a “profound crisis” of governance, security and public confidence.“We must restore the democratic rights and economic emancipation of the people of Bangladesh, give them back their voice and ensure that the future of Bangladesh is decided by the people of Bangladesh themselves,” she said. “That is my responsibility. That is my commitment and I will not abandon that,” Hasina said, noting that she will share in detail her plan for how she will return to Bangladesh in Dec this year.Hasina made the remarks while addressing online a seminar titled “Safeguarding Democracy in Bangladesh: Rights, Freedoms and the Rule of Law” at Godfrey Mitchell Room of One Great George Street in London.The seminar was organised by the Global Center for Democratic Governance (GCDG), Canada and the UK. GCDG identifies itself as an organisation focused on democracy, good governance, justice and human rights in Bangladesh. Other speakers included Sajeeb Wazed Joy, former adviser to prime minister of Bangladesh, UK MP Bob Blackman and former European Parliament member Paulo Casaca.Hasina, now based in New Delhi, said that although she had been away from Bangladesh for more than two years, she remained connected with people in the country. “Every day I hear from people of Bangladesh,” she said.You use AI every day. articles.summary: UTTARKASHI: Following heavy rainfall and snowfall in the high-altitude Himalayan region on September 26 and 27, the Gangotri National Park administration
articles.body: UTTARKASHI: Following heavy rainfall and snowfall in the high-altitude Himalayan region on September 26 and 27, the Gangotri National Park administration has suspended entry into the park area until further orders, citing the safety of tourists and trekkers.Mayank Garg, Deputy Director of Gangotri National Park, told TOI that the heavy rain and snow have made various trekking routes within the park—including Gangotri-Gaumukh-Tapovan, Gartang Gali, and Kedartal—hazardous; the paths have sustained damage in several places and are currently being repaired.The park is expected to reopen to tourists and trekkers within two to three days once all routes are restored.Entry into the park area will remain prohibited until further notice to ensure the safety of tourists and trekkers.Meanwhile, Manoj Rawat, Secretary of the Uttarkashi Trekking Association, expressed concern over the sudden closure of trekking routes.He noted that tourists are facing inconvenience, as many have made advance bookings, and trekking companies have already arranged for rations, equipment, and other essential supplies.He argued that the park administration should not impose restrictions on the safer, easier routes.Stay updated with the latest Dehradun news. articles.title: Wife locked in bedroom, leaking gas, missing caretaker: Ex-IAS officer Rakesh Agrawal’s murder in Bhopal home gets murkier
articles.summary: BHOPAL: In what could be a crucial piece of information amid the probe into the gruesome killing of retired IAS officer Rakesh Agrawal, his widow, Nishi,
articles.body: BHOPAL: In what could be a crucial piece of information amid the probe into the gruesome killing of retired IAS officer Rakesh Agrawal, his widow, Nishi, told police that she tried opening her bedroom door around 4.40 am on Wednesday, but found it locked from outside.The statement deepened the mystery around the killing after Amar, a cook employed by the family, told the cops that he spotted Varun, the 24x7 caretaker and now the absconding prime suspect, loitering outside the house around 1 am, adding that on being enquired, the latter said he came to check after hearing the sound of a door being opened.Amar said he retired to his room thereafter, while Varun proceeded towards Agrawal’s room.Nishi told the sleuths that on finding her bedroom door locked from outside, she informed Neetu, Amar’s wife who lives with him at the adjacent servants’ quarters. Neetu then informed her husband, who had a duplicate key to the house, the police said.Amar rushed in to find the main door, too, locked from outside, the sleuths said, adding that he opened it before unlocking the bedroom door.As they stepped out of the bedroom, they caught a strong whiff of leaking gas throughout the house. Proceeding to the kitchen to check, they found all LPG cylinder pipes disconnected. Amar quickly removed the cylinders to prevent a fire.They then went to Agrawal’s room, finding him in bed, the police said, adding as Nishi tried to nudge him awake, her hand was smeared with blood. She screamed aloud in horror, while Amar reached over to check for pulse. He didn’t find any.They then looked around for the caretaker but he had disappeared.ACP Ankita Khatarkar said the retired IAS officer had been discharged from hospital about 20 days ago, after recovering from a slipped disc-related condition.The sleuths, who swept the scene, said the LPG connecting pipes could well have been deliberately dislodged in a bid to set off a fire. In a crucial lead, police said the suspect was captured on a CCTV camera in Suraj Nagar around 2.15 am, appearing to be making an escape.The murder, according to the police, was likely committed sometime between 12.30 am and 2 am on Wednesday.The body, meanwhile, was sent for post-mortem and kept in a freezer at the mortuary after the procedure. Benumbed with shock after finding her husband murdered, Nishi experienced a sudden spike in blood pressure and was taken to a hospital.Ratibad police questioned the operator of the agency in Bag Sewania through which caretaker Varun was hired.According to the agency operator, Varun contacted him in Aug 2026 on a number he found online and later travelled to Bhopal from Patiala, Punjab. articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has questioned who authorised changes to the online Form 6 for voter
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has questioned who authorised changes to the online Form 6 for voter registration and whether Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) was pressured to implement them.“The online Form 6 was changed illegally - as the EC's own Commissioners have recorded. And were they pressured into doing it?” Rahul said in a post on X.The Election Commission has withdrawn the additional Special Intensive Revision (SIR)-related declaration attached to Form 6 in states where the electoral roll revision exercise has been completed, PTI reported on Wednesday.The declaration has been removed from the ECINET app and portal, as well as the respective Chief Electoral Officer portals, meaning new applicants in these states will only have to submit the regular statutory Form 6 for voter enrolment.In states and Union territories where the SIR exercise is still underway, the additional declaration remains available on the ECINET portal. articles.title: British Transport Police spent £320,786 testing live facial recognition at London stations and scanned more than 500,000 faces; the six-month trial produced one alert, and that person was wrongly identified
articles.summary: A six-month trial of live facial recognition at London railway stations cost British Transport Police (BTP) £320,786 and scanned more than 500,000 faces,
articles.body: A six-month trial of live facial recognition at London railway stations cost British Transport Police (BTP) £320,786 and scanned more than 500,000 faces, but it produced just one alert from the police watchlist. That alert turned out to be a false identification, with no arrest resulting directly from the technology during the trial period. The findings were reported by The Guardian, which reviewed a freedom of information document obtained by Liberty Investigates. The trial ran between February and July 2026 and involved 18 deployments at some of London’s busiest transport hubs. BTP has since extended the programme, raising fresh questions about cost, accuracy, privacy and whether live facial recognition is proportionate for use across a public transport network.How the trial workedLive facial recognition cameras compare faces passing through a particular location with images on a police watchlist. The system is designed to identify people who may be wanted by the police or subject to court restrictions. The cameras do not treat every person as a suspect. According to former biometrics and surveillance camera commissioner Fraser Sampson, the system’s use depends on the composition of the watchlist and whether the people being sought are likely to appear at the chosen location and time.During the London trial, cameras were deployed at railway stations between February and July. More than half a million faces were scanned during those operations, while officers and specialist equipment were positioned at 18 separate deployments. The trial was intended to explore whether the technology could help identify wanted offenders and people breaching court orders. British Transport Police also said the system could support efforts to tackle violence against women and girls, particularly in transport environments where concerns about harassment and sexual offences can affect how people travel.One alert, and it was wrongThe technology produced one alert against a person on the police watchlist. Officers checked the result, but the individual was not the person sought. The alert was therefore classified as a false positive. No arrest resulted directly from an LFR alert during the six-month trial. The equipment hire and police staffing costs came to £320,786, while officers spent almost 100 hours supporting the operations.BTP said officers made other arrests during the deployments, including arrests linked to assault, theft, possession of an offensive weapon, public order offences and breaches of criminal behaviour orders. Police also located individuals wanted by courts and other forces. However, BTP acknowledged that these arrests did not result directly from facial recognition alerts. They were therefore excluded from the official LFR performance data. That distinction is important because it separates the general policing activity surrounding the trial from the results produced by the facial recognition system itself. The wider deployments may have helped officers identify or respond to other incidents, but the technology generated one watchlist alert, and it was inaccurate.Why police are continuing the programmeDespite the limited results, BTP extended the trial for an additional four months. The extension expanded the deployments to include London Underground stations. The force said the first phase helped it understand how the technology could be used most effectively in a railway environment. It also said procedures had been refined around deployment locations, equipment, watchlist construction and operational safeguards.BTP reported that since the extension began, there had been three confirmed positive alerts. However, those individuals were later confirmed to be complying with sexual harm prevention orders or other court-imposed conditions. A positive alert does not necessarily mean that someone has committed a new offence. It indicates that the system has identified a person who appears to match an image on the watchlist. Officers must then verify the person’s identity and determine what action, if any, is appropriate.The force said watchlist growth had been deliberately controlled. It began with a smaller list while staff worked to ensure data quality, governance and safeguarding arrangements were robust.Concerns about accuracy and proportionalityThe trial has renewed debate over whether live facial recognition is appropriate for crowded public spaces. Critics argue that members of the public are being scanned without individually consenting, even when they have done nothing wrong. The technology also processes biometric information, which is considered sensitive personal data. The fact that one alert was incorrect during the trial has raised concerns about how false matches can affect people who are stopped, questioned or exposed to police intervention, as per the report.A growing use of facial recognitionMore than half of police forces in England and Wales have now used live facial recognition on public streets, according to an analysis by Liberty Investigates. The technology is also expanding in London. The Metropolitan police and the mayor’s office announced plans for fixed facial recognition cameras in the West End. Mayor Sadiq Khan has confirmed that the technology will be used on the newly pedestrianised Oxford Street. The expansion has taken place while Parliament continues to debate the legal safeguards surrounding artificial intelligence and biometric surveillance. A recent report from the Joint Committee on Human Rights described live facial recognition as a particularly clear example of the risks created by AI.Bell Ribeiro-Addy, the Labour MP for Clapham and Brixton Hill, called the technology a serious invasion of privacy and said its rollout should be suspended until stronger safeguards and a clear legal framework are in place.What happens nextThe BTP trial is continuing, but its early results have made the debate more complicated. Police have said the technology can help identify people who pose a risk to passengers and staff, while critics argue that the financial cost and privacy implications require much stronger evidence of effectiveness.The programme’s next phase will provide more data, particularly now that London Underground stations have been added. Officials will need to assess not only the number of alerts, but also their accuracy, the number of arrests that directly follow them and the impact on people who are wrongly flagged.For passengers, the issue is not simply whether a camera can recognise a face. It is whether the system can do so accurately, fairly and under rules that protect people who are not suspected of wrongdoing.After scanning more than 500,000 faces at a cost of over £320,000, the first six months produced one alert and one false identification. The extended trial will determine whether that result was an unusually weak beginning or a sign of the practical limits of live facial recognition in Britain’s busiest transport spaces.You use AI every day. articles.title: Flydubai flight FZ1073: How Captain Machchhar’s quick thinking to open cockpit door helped save 174 lives
articles.summary: The cockpit door of Flydubai Flight FZ1073 was reportedly opened by the wounded Captain Smit Machchhar from the floor, allowing passengers to enter after
articles.body: The cockpit door of Flydubai Flight FZ1073 was reportedly opened by the wounded Captain Smit Machchhar from the floor, allowing passengers to enter after he was allegedly stabbed by his co-pilot.Passengers are reported to have subdued the alleged attacker before a second set of pilots, who were due to take over the flight, ultimately landed the aircraft safely at Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia.Jinit Shah, a urologist and neighbour of the pilot’s family in Mumbai’s Ghatkopar, said Smit is known for making quick decisions. “He has been training pilots and has an academy of his own, and that may be why he knows what to do in an emergency,” Shah said.“Because of muscle memory, he might have been able to handle the situation even after being stabbed and save 174 lives,” he said.The incident has also renewed attention on cockpit security and the access available to flight crew members. Before 9/11, flight deck doors were often as flimsy as lavatory doors. Following the attacks, cockpit doors were reinforced to create a significant barrier against anyone outside the flight deck attempting to enter.New aircraft in the US are also required to have a secondary physical barrier to protect the cockpit when the flight deck door is opened.If a flight crew member intends to commit a criminal act, they may already have the necessary access. However, the final layer of security ultimately relies on trusting those responsible for operating the aircraft.The flight departed Dubai at 6.05 am (local time) and was flying west towards its destination near Tel Aviv. About two hours after takeoff, the aircraft began losing altitude rapidly and turned sharply north, according to flight-tracking data. It descended 17,400 feet in just under two minutes.The flight issued a distress call at 8.31 am (local time), shortly before squawking code 7500, the International Civil Aviation Organization code used to indicate a hijacking. Passengers described chaotic scenes on board as the aircraft rapidly descended.The incident is being investigated as a possible attempted terrorist attack. The alleged attacker, an Omani national, has been taken into Saudi custody, while his motive remains unclear. Reports have cited a fellow pilot who described the man as displaying what he considered unusually strict religious behaviour.The reports have also raised questions over how the Omani national was cleared to operate a flight to Israel, given that Oman does not have diplomatic relations with Israel.Machchhar was hospitalised in stable condition, according to the Indian Embassy in Saudi Arabia. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu credited the Indian captain with saving the lives of all 174 people on board.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Why road to heaven feels like hell
articles.summary: By Jaya Row Do you feel you would have lived life better if you had known so many things you did not know then?
articles.body: By Jaya RowDo you feel you would have lived life better if you had known so many things you did not know then? How many more painful lessons would you have to learn to live a fulfilled life? What if you could learn to live wisely, without having to go through suffering?You get weighed down with worry, anxiety, and grief. Is the world giving you sorrow? Or could it be that you have not learnt the technique of dealing with the world?Gita gives knowledge of the world, yourself, and art of right contact with the world. It begins with Arjun’s grief. Arjun, mighty warrior, accomplished archer, and commander of Pandav forces is overwhelmed and unable to act. Krishn does not console Arjun. He gives him knowledge. As Arjun’s understanding deepens, his confusion disappears. At the end of Gita, he rises, fights the battle, and wins. The battlefield has not changed. Arjun has.Life is misleading. The road to heaven feels like hell. And the road to hell is heavenly. One demands discipline. The other rewards temptation. One asks you to be patient. The other whispers – take the easy way.Sense enjoyment gives pleasure. So, you indulge in it indiscriminately. But the law of diminishing returns functions. The more you indulge the less you enjoy. The answer is not rejection, but regulation.We believe selfishness is the way to go. Yet thought of self is the greatest obstacle to success, happiness, and growth. Fix a higher goal. When the mind expands, it is capable of clear thinking, creative output, and dynamic work.Love is oxygen of our hearts. When the soul is deprived of love it fades, withers, and dies. But our love is tainted by selfishness. This is called attachment. It comes from a lack of self-sufficiency. You depend on your loved ones. You have expectations from them and make demands on them. And when these expectations are not met with, there is disappointment, frustration, and conflict. Continue the love. Drop expectations. And watch the result!Before you play a game – cricket, football, or tennis – you first need to learn the rules of the game. However talented you may be, if you don’t know the rules you lose. You have entered the arena of life. Do you know the rules of the game of life?The world is a mix of pairs of opposites. It is in a constant flux of change. And the change is unpredictable. In short, the world is undependable. Everything in the world is passing, ephemeral, finite. Yet you project a false sense of permanence on the world. And are heartbroken when it goes.Possess the world, enjoy it fully. But never depend on it. Amid this kaleidoscope of change, do what you have to do. Play your part to the best of your ability. With sincerity and dedication. And you will grow to the state of spiritual awakening.Jaya Row will give talks on Bhagwad Gita Ch 2 in Mumbai, October 8 to 10, 7 to 8.15 pm.
